fields.label: Caveats
items: The paper cites V1. Reproductions that need the example raw tag files must use V2. Record which version was used.
The code README (DS-SCH23-CODE) says the example tag files are under 10.5281/zenodo.7979319, but they're only in V2 (7997998).
